name: collaboraoffice
description:
Collabora Office brings the familiar Collabora Online experience to your computer - so you can create, edit, and present with a beautiful, modern UI. Built on LibreOffice, it delivers excellent interoperability with ODF and Microsoft Office formats (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), and exports to PDF with ease. Your documents stay on your device unless you choose to share them - privacy by design.

This is an unofficial community AppImage packaging, not affiliated with or endorsed by Collabora Productivity.
